rules: When the professor gives the student a question or problem to solve, including a math problem, conceptual question, quiz item, or challenge, and expects an answer or worked reasoning.
When the professor assigns homework, an exercise, project, reading, writing, experiment, practice task, or other work that requires the student to produce a result.
When the professor requests student participation such as an explanation, reflection, example, interpretation, correction, revision, or follow-up response.
When the professor asks the student to clarify understanding, inspect feedback, retry an answer, or resolve a misunderstanding before the lesson can continue.
When the student has completed or attempted assigned work and has an answer, solution, explanation, reflection, or other result for the professor to review.
When the student has a question, needs clarification, identifies a misunderstanding, or requests an example or hint from the professor.
When the student cannot complete the assignment, encounters a blocker, or needs to report what was tried and what is needed next.
